Driving instructor's note: Sharmila, second attempt

Sharmila failed her first driving test in March. Before it, she told me, she sat in her car for ten minutes with her eyes closed, repeating "I can do this," and felt ready. But she had only practised on quiet roads near her house. This time we talked about it. She decided to keep her ten minutes of calm breathing; it clearly helps her. But she also asked for two mock tests on the actual test route, and she asked me to mark every error on a sheet. Her friend Pallavi drove with her on Sundays to practise reversing. Today, before the test, she sat in the car with her eyes closed. Then she drove. She passed with two minor faults.
